import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    q = next(it)

    bit = [0] * (n + 1)
    arr = [0] * (n + 1)

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        v = next(it)
        arr[i] = v
        j = i
        while j <= n:
            bit[j] += v
            j += j & -j

    out = []

    for _ in range(q):
        t = next(it)
        if t == 0:
            k = next(it)
            p = next(it)
            delta = p - arr[k]
            arr[k] = p
            if delta:
                j = k
                while j <= n:
                    bit[j] += delta
                    j += j & -j
        else:
            k = next(it)
            s = 0
            j = k
            while j > 0:
                s += bit[j]
                j -= j & -j
            out.append(str(s))

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
